triggered_indicators.detail: SMS traffic is 96.4% of total events (threshold: >90%). Strongly indicates an OTP/alert receiver role.
SIM received traffic from 15 distinct financial institutions (threshold: ≥5). A single user holding 5+ active bank accounts on one prepaid SIM is characteristic of a mule account cluster.
Detected 24 outgoing verification SMS to UPI gateway numbers. This pattern is generated by batch-binding multiple UPI wallet apps to bank accounts on a new device.
SIM card swapped across 4 unique IMEIs (1.2 swaps/month) over 99 days. Coordinated device handoffs are used to evade IMEI-based fraud tracking.

Voice calls stopped after the first 9% of the active period (90.9% of total time was voice-silent). This 'line warming then abandonment' pattern is typical of an operational SIM after the testing phase.
Only 1 recurring personal contacts found. Genuine users maintain a stable social network of 10+ contacts. This SIM shows near-zero personal social activity.
Detected activity in known high-risk telecom circle(s). 14.7% of events originated from circles flagged as cyber-fraud operational hubs.
75% of all unique contacts are financial institutions or UPI services (threshold: >60%). No substantial personal messaging detected.
